review_method: Manual review of saved plan/support-detail against HB92 foot-bracket plan and intermediate-shaft side detail; SNL6 cross-check.
observations: Vertical journal and both rod eye/pin axes now agree with the visible plan faces and edge-on side projection in HB92.
The new M640 has two eyes on the same side of its pivot. The complete M578 connects the outer eye to the retained M4132 horizontal lever.
The new support is an integral upright journal on a riveted triangular foot, rather than the rejected tall transverse cantilever.
This confirms topology only: the neutral clocking, arm radii, journal size/height and casting dimensions remain explicitly approximate.
limitations: Remaining inner eye awaits M579; full connected layout still open.
No dimensional camera fit is claimed for the broken-length source. Qualitative topology comparison was sufficient to reject the prior orientation, but cannot establish exact dimensions.
